name: DOA YANG TERLINDUNG
overview:
The story of two influential Islamic sisters, Layla and Amina, who are adored by many for their robed image and generous nature.

The two lead Laymina Shares, a charitable foundation that has successfully gained the trust of the community to the point of mobilizing thousands of followers to donate through various campaigns.

Ustaz Irfan (Firdaus Karim), a famous preacher and religious icon on social media, is respected as the main instructor at Baitul Khadijah and is the idol of many female students. Despite his perfect image, his peace begins to be threatened when Anisah (Sharifah Rose), a brave and different new student, arrives at Baitul Khadijah to continue her studies according to her parents' wishes, despite her ambition to become a Muslim fashion consultant. Her presence sparks attention, criticism and unexpected conflict at the institution.
